title: Language-Dependent Political Bias in AI: A Study of ChatGPT and Gemini
findings: Along with 'Personal Social Values', 'Religion' was identified as one of the two strongest factors influencing the measured political bias of both ChatGPT and Gemini. The models' responses to questions in the religion category significantly impacted their position on the political compass.
